review: The hymn is the question of consecration: 1:1–4 is Num 11:23 (הֲיַד יְהוָה תִּקְצָר) with Exod 19:10, the chorus is Josh 3:5 (הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ) with John 14:12, 2:1–4 is Rom 12:1 with 2 Cor 12:9, 3:1–4 is 1 Pet 4:10–11, and 4:1–4 is Col 3:23 with Rom 11:36.

The chorus's first line is the threefold 'yes' plus the formula of the divine speech, as the print has نَعَمْ نَعَمْ نَعَمْ يَقُولُ رَبُّنَا; the Hebrew keeps the triple and the colon-convention before the quoted words.

1:1 and the openings of stanzas 2–4 all end on the same half-line (אֲדֹנָי בִּי / אֲדֹנָי אֶת־), following the print's repeated هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ الرَّبُّ أَنْ; the payload uses the same Hebrew frame each time and lets the enjambment carry the object.
